CA.name: California
protections: Hospital Fair Pricing Act — hospitals must offer financial assistance to uninsured and underinsured patients earning up to 400% FPL
No Surprises Act (federal) applies to all emergency services
Balance billing prohibited for in-network hospital emergency services
Itemized bill must be provided upon request within 30 days
CA.key_agency: Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI)

TX.name: Texas
protections: No Surprises Act (federal) applies to emergency services
Texas Balance Billing Law (SB 1264) — protects against surprise bills in emergencies and at in-network facilities
Itemized bill available upon request
Nonprofit hospitals required to provide charity care per IRS 501(r)

FL.name: Florida
protections: No Surprises Act (federal) applies to emergency services
Florida Patient Protection Act — requires price transparency from hospitals
Itemized bill must be provided upon request
Nonprofit hospitals required to provide charity care per IRS 501(r)
FL.key_agency: Florida Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA)

AZ.name: Arizona
protections: No Surprises Act (federal) applies to emergency services
Arizona Surprise Billing Law requires dispute resolution for out-of-network bills
Itemized bill available upon request
Nonprofit hospitals required to provide charity care per IRS 501(r)
AZ.key_agency: Arizona Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions

NY.name: New York
protections: No Surprises Act (federal) applies to emergency services
New York Surprise Bill Law — comprehensive protections including independent dispute resolution
Hospital Financial Assistance Law — mandatory charity care for patients under 300% FPL
Itemized bill must be provided upon request
NY.key_agency: New York State Department of Financial Services

NV.name: Nevada
protections: No Surprises Act (federal) applies to emergency services
Nevada requires hospitals to post chargemaster prices online
Itemized bill available upon request
Nonprofit hospitals required to provide charity care per IRS 501(r)

IL.name: Illinois
protections: No Surprises Act (federal) applies to emergency services
Illinois Hospital Uninsured Patient Discount Act — uninsured patients receive substantial discounts
Community Benefits Act — nonprofit hospitals must provide charity care
Itemized bill available upon request

TX.name: Texas
protections: No Surprises Act (federal) for emergency services
SB 1264 protects against surprise medical bills
Hospital price transparency required
